deterministic_evidence.detail: tag truth is recomputed from the live DOM at verify time; the agent's finding is compared against it

instruction: Open the CHANEL GB product page. Inspect the LIVE page (page HTML, script tags, window globals) for marketing tags, then record your finding by setting window.__bench_finding with ONE eval to a JSON object with exactly these keys: {"gtm": [every GTM container id found anywhere in the page, each matching /GTM-[A-Z0-9]+/], "googleAds": [every Google Ads id matching /AW-[0-9]{6,}/], "pinterest": true if a Pinterest tag is present (window.pintrk is defined, or a ct.pinterest.com / pintrk reference exists), else false}. Do not change the page. Finish only after window.__bench_finding is set.
objective: On the live CHANEL GB product page for the Bouton de Camelia earrings (J13850), record which marketing tags the page actually carries: the GTM container id set, Google Ads (AW-) ids and Pinterest tag presence.

pre_state.detail: navigate to the public product page in a fresh browser context; no account, no login, no prior cart or session state

provenance.verified_against: window.__bench_finding matches the independently recomputed tag ground truth for the live page (GTM container id set, Google Ads AW- id set, Pinterest presence)

raw_task_statement: please complete the production QA of the google ads tags described in .../2026-08_media_qa-matrix_workspaces_v1_1_TESTED.xlsx ... ideally we want to confirm every tag is working (other than purchase, we should validate purchases via google ads in-platform reporting) I have all the relevant chanel website tabs open in my omc chrome profile ... please connect to it and use playwriter to complete the QA

verification.description: Independent recomputation of the tag ground truth from the live page, compared to the agent's window.__bench_finding (never the agent's self-report alone).
